manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of copying Venser
easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a nonland permanent with an equal or lesser mana value than the one you wish to donate.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Puca's Mischief triggers, exchanging control of a nonland permanent an opponent controls with equal or lesser mana value and Venser.
Cast your clone spell from the templated list for its mana cost, choosing to have it enter as a copy of Venser.
Each Venser that entered triggers. Put those triggers on the stack, choosing the second mode and targeting the Venser your opponent controls for at least one copy.
Resolve a Venser trigger, creating two copies of a permanent an opponent controls (this must be Venser if you only put one trigger on the stack in Step 3).
Repeat Step 4 until you have created two copies of Venser.
Repeat from Step 3. Depending on the permanents targeted in Step 4, the features produced will change.
